subject: Request: Exec signoff — bespoke remedial credit tranche for Avery Labs
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@averylabs.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com, support@redwood.com
Cc: ops@averylabs.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Spike in tail latency affecting LiveSearch (support #9821)

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the quick triage call earlier. To be frank, this week’s tail latency spike (p50 stable but p99 jumped ~6-8s during our morning batch window on 2026-11-09) caused a measurable hit to our user experience on LiveSearch—query completion rate dropped and we saw roughly a 12% lift in error retries. We opened ticket #9821 and attached our internal timing traces (sent to support).

Given we’re mid-renewal and evaluating cost/perf across vendors, this incident is material for us. We appreciate the team’s investigation notes, but we need a concrete remedial proposal: a one-off credit or service concession that recognizes the customer impact and shows goodwill while we decide on renewal cadence.

Can your account team propose something quantifiable by end of week? Our procurement lead is available next Wednesday for a short call.

—Marta
Director of Platform Engineering
Avery Labs

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Spike in tail latency affecting LiveSearch (support #9821) — need exec signoff request

Team, forwarding Avery’s note (attached). Summary: p99 tail latency regression on 2026-11-09 impacted LiveSearch; customer surfaced reduction in query completion and a spike in retries. They are mid-renewal (deal attached).

Proposed remedial offer (commercial + operational):
- Commercial: hybrid concession — one month of service credit (tier equivalent) + a one-time billing credit of $20,000 applied to next invoice.
- Operational: dedicated SLO playbook and two-week performance follow-up with infra+SRE (we’ve already scheduled an audit run).

Rationale: this is more conservative than the $45k ask they implied but better aligns with churn-risk and internal precedents (see attachment "proposed-credit-calculation.xlsx"). It keeps gross margin hit contained while giving Avery a visible concession tied to renewal.

Ask: Exec signoff required (Jonas or Karthik) — need approval or counter-offer by EOD Mon 2026-11-16 because Avery’s procurement has a renewal meeting on 2026-11-20. If approved, I’ll draft the amendment and route DocuSign. Attachments: uptime digest (pdf), support case export, credit calc sheet.

Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: avery-uptime-digest-2026Q3.pdf, proposed-credit-calculation.xlsx, support-case-#9821.eml]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 07:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Spike in tail latency affecting LiveSearch (support #9821)

Camila — quick Qs before I sign:
1) Is the $20k figure net of bill-back adjustments and already-accounted credits this quarter? Need to avoid double-counting with any month-of-service credit.
2) Do we have precedent for the combination (1 month + one-time credit) in deals of this ARR band? Marissa, thoughts on precedent?
3) What's the finance impact and GL coding — will this be a contra-revenue credit or marketing credit? I want to ensure legal and finance ok with the wording for the amendment.

If we can confirm that the combined net impact is ~ $22–25k and we can secure a renewal commitment (term extension or expanded seat count) at signature, I’m inclined to greenlight. But need the numbers and a DocuSign-ready amendment draft.

—Karthik
Head of Sales Operations

On Mon, 16 Nov 2026 at 06:50 Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marissa flagged a similar hybrid concession in Q2 for a MidMarket account; I’ll pull the exact reference.
>
> Camila

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Spike in tail latency affecting LiveSearch (support #9821) — approval

Camila / team — thanks for the concise package and the proposed structure. I’ve reviewed the support case and the attached credit calc. I’m approving a modified concession:

1) One month of service credit (applied to the billing period following execution).
2) One-time billing credit of $20,000.
3) Contingency: the concession is conditional on Avery executing the renewal amendment (12-month extension) within 30 days of the amendment being sent. If they decline to renew within that window, we revert to a reduced arrangement (service credit only).

Karthik — route as contra-revenue credit; finance signoff already discussed with Irene (she’ll confirm GL code). Camila — proceed to prepare the amendment and DocuSign packet. Include the operational remediation plan and schedule the two-week follow-up with their SREs.

Jonas Weber
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

[Next steps checklist: draft amendment -> legal review -> DocuSign -> apply credit on next invoice upon execution]
